object.name: evi.onepole.shelving~
object.digest: Onepole shelving filters with simultaneous outputs
object.description: Onepole low/high shelving filter using trapezoidal integration, simultaneous outputs, very smooth and very cheap. Frequency input in Hz, shelving input is linear -1..0..1, optional smoothing attributes are default off.

inlets.description: The center frequency around which the filters attenuate or boost the input signal.

The amount of shelving. A special normalised control: 0 = the filters are bypassed. -1..0 the filters are attenuating shelves. 0..1 the filters are boosting shelves. -1..1 equates to about ± -10..10 dB.

attributes.name: smoothfreq
attributes.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the frequency inlet control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.

attributes.name: smoothshelf
attributes.description: The time in ms with which to smooth the shelving inlet control. If 0, smoothing is CPU-off.
